content: TIMOTI NDI KAT KWUNAPMAK KAT POL AY WANDƗ

Ngwuk kat vɨvak kat ana alɨpsɨga kawiga lɨgiyanɨn. Ngi kat tɨga nɨna mbaapma nyan Timoti kat wali, ngwuk kat yindɨ. Ndɨ Godna njɨvwa kwutɨga nyana. Ndɨ Kraist waa apma nyaangɨt mbutɨga nyana. Ngwutna maawupa God waa apma nyaangɨk kat nɨmamba kwutaa lɨngwa vat kwunapmak kat wali, yindɨ. Ngwuk kat mbupmak kat wali, yindɨ. Yindɨ maa Atensmba kapma lɨga.

Nɨma sakwat nɨmba apma vapmba tɨngwangat aki waa ngwuk kat kavle vapmba yilɨgandi. Wan apma vat kwagalangwangat nɨn kai walɨganɨn. God nɨn kat kwutaa wandɨ. Nat nɨmba ngwuk kat kavle vapmba yigiyandi waa wandɨ. Vɨga lɨgangwuk.
Tat ngwulogwinala lɨna njɨmbla ngwuk kat wupma mbutnɨn. Nat nɨmba nɨn kat kavle vapmba yigiyandi waa mbutnɨn. Mbutna vapmba tɨgandɨ. Wan vak vɨga lɨgangwuk.

Wungi kat tɨga ngwuk kat vɨvak kat ana alɨpsɨga kawiga lɨgiywoun. Wungivak kat tɨga Timoti kat wowun mala yindɨ. God waa nyaangɨt ngwula maawupmba kwutaa lɨgangwuk? Tamba kwagalangwuk? Waa wagalavat yindɨ. Wun yelavɨkwun. Kavle maawut kwilɨga nyan, Seten ndi kat kavle maawut kwindɨ mala ndinogwinala kwutna njɨvwa kwo valat anagandɨ ya waa yelavɨkwun. Ngwuk kat vɨlaa yetɨngwa vak wun kat mbukiyandɨ.
TIMOTI APMA NYAANGƗT MBUTNDƗ, POL SOLAT SƗNDƗ

Timoti ngwuk kat yilaa lungwamataa yalaa ngwutna nyaangɨt nɨn kat mbutndɨ. God waa nyaangɨtmba nɨmamba kwutaa lɨgandi. Nat nɨmba kat woviyaguga lɨga kwunatɨgandi. Ngwuk kat vɨvat walɨgandi. Apma vapmba ngwuk kat yelavɨka lɨgandɨ waa nɨn kat mbutndɨ. Nɨno ngwuk kat vɨvat tɨganɨn.

Kɨta mbaapma nɨmba, nɨn kat nɨma vat ya vak kat ana nɨmamba yelavɨka vaatɨganɨn. Kavle vat nɨn kat yinjeya vak kat ana nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨganɨn. God waa apma nyaangɨt maawupmba nɨma vat kwutaa lɨngwa vak kat mɨna yelavɨka nɨna maawut apma vat tɨgandɨ.
Njambwi nyan waa nyaangɨtmba ngwuk nɨmamba kwutaalɨngweyan nɨn solat sɨga apma vat tɨgiyanɨn.
Ngwuk apma vak yetɨngwa vak kat tɨga god kat mbutɨganɨn. Mbuka solat sɨlɨganɨn. God kat walɨganɨn. Ndi kat apma vat yimɨn waa walɨganɨn. God kat ngwuk kat tɨga mbuka sɨvu kɨlɨganɨn.
Nandinya ngan ngwutna mɨndama vɨvak kat God kat wagalalɨganɨn. Ngwutyna maawupmba lɨga vat tambɨ kalalɨndeyan nɨn kwunakiyanɨn.
NDINAI LƗGA KAVA YIVAK KAT GOD KAT POL WAGALANDƗ
Nɨna nyaek Godnogwi nɨna njambwi nyan Jisaso mbɨk vɨlɨlɨk palɨ nɨn kat ngwulai lɨga kavat kaligiyambɨt wanɨn.

Njambwi nyan kat ngwuk kat tɨga wowun. Awat sowat woviyaguga kwunaka tɨnjeya vak ndi kat nɨmamba agwi. Nat nɨmba kat woviyaguga kwunaka tɨnjeya vat ndi kat nɨmamba agwi waa wowun. Ngwuk kat woviyaguga tɨneya vat nɨn kat tamba kwindɨ.

Njambwi nyan Jisas ndɨna mbaapma nɨmbonala yaiga njɨmblamba ngwutna maawut apma vat tɨndangat wowun. Wan njɨmbla nɨna nyaek God ngwutna maawupmba lɨgiyaa vak kat vɨlaa kavle vatna waa ana waigandɨ wowun. Maawupmba lɨga kavle vat ana vɨgiyandɨ wowun.
